topic: Testing frame signal on DP08 device
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on testing a high signal level (53.4) for a device-type frame in the RMS system. [p1] suggested using their DP08 device for testing, noting that previous versions of the firmware caused freezing issues. They plan to test this on a router connected to [p1]'s setup, which will also allow other devices to be updated and tested. The goal is to eventually move to the latest version due to its improved admin UI.
decisions: Testing of frame signal (53.4) will be conducted using the DP08 device.
action_items: Test the high signal level for a device-type frame on the DP08 router setup.
